column1: # THE FOUR SEMANTIC STREAMS, EMITTED FRESH over the SOURCE-DERIVED
# FIXTURE SET by ONE mechanism: the compiled PolyC semantic-stream
#   G0  the legacy C oracle: the REAL selector-OFF decision bodies of
#       VERBATIM into a disposable, never-committed harness, with the
#   G1  the compiled PolyC subject produced by PRODUCER 1
#   G2  the compiled PolyC subject produced by PRODUCER 2
#   G3  the compiled PolyC subject produced by PRODUCER 3
# The emitter CALLS each stream's decision function. The stream is the
# decision's OWN output, not a transcription of it.
# The G0 oracle and the G1..G3 subjects are compared over the SAME
# admissible domain. The production call site computes is_float as
# irIsFloat(a->type), a BOOLEAN, so the admissible domain of is_float
# is {0,1}; an is_float outside that domain is an out-of-domain INPUT
# and both streams fail closed on it. The legacy table's own
# `if (is_float)` is a TRUTHINESS test, and applying it to an
